issues.description: The problem statement contains a contradictory instruction about how to start the client. It tells students to run the client via Starter (correct) but immediately says “Do not run H05E01ClientApplication!”, which is confusing because Starter launches H05E01ClientApplication. This is a textual/structural inconsistency that can mislead students about the correct entry point to start the client application.
issues.suggested_fix: Clarify the instructions in the problem statement. For example, replace the sentence with: “To run the client locally use the Starter class (which launches H05E01ClientApplication); do not start the client by running H05E01ClientApplication directly.” Or simply remove the “Do not run H05E01ClientApplication!” sentence to avoid confusion.
